issues.subject: Army automates ATOs and opens drone ranges; GSA reprices AI
lines: Army's Project Gatekeeper goes live to cut software ATOs to near-real-time pipeline checks.
Army adds two Indiana sites to its list of permissive ranges for commercial drone and counter-drone testing.
SOCOM gives Smack Technologies an OT worth up to $7.5M to prototype AI campaign planning.
Office of Strategic Capital offers Stoke Space a $150M conditional loan for a Cape Canaveral launch pad.
GSA's new Anthropic OneGov deal moves Claude to consumption pricing at a 40% discount.
Pentagon says it obligated 97.5% of FY2026 reconciliation money; Iran war costs top $47B.
DHS takes its procurement forecast system offline Oct. 30 during a migration.
Air Force puts ARRW into production with a $694M Lockheed award and taps startup Castelion for F-16 hypersonics.
